d:
The 76ers defeated the Knicks, 98-93 tonight in Philadelphia. Tyrese Maxey finished with a team-high 27 points along with 4 rebounds and 4 assists for the 76ers, while Anfernee Simons tallied 21 points, 5 three pointers and 2 rebounds in the game. Jalen Brunson recorded 24 points, 6 assists and 5 rebounds. The 76ers improve their record to 5-1 with the win, while the Knicks fall to 2-4 for the season.
